completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Continuous V6 product hardening and optimization
active_mission.objective: Keep one clean current Hixton V6 product and continuously improve its ten USDC coin profiles. Product backtests expose exactly one current scenario. Every normal single, 10x250 and shared 3x80 backtest must cover exactly three calendar years from the chosen safe report_end_utc back to the same UTC timestamp three calendar years earlier; 400 one-hour warm-up bars are extra history before that window and never part of reported performance. If exact coverage is unavailable, fail closed instead of shortening. The fixed-window current-V6 regression reference for 2023-09-19T19:00:00Z..2026-09-19T19:00:00Z is 8217.00711069101365 USDC isolated 10x250 and 1217.9057596598351 USDC shared 3x80 using BTC VIDYA5, ADA band 4.4, AVAX band 4.6 and DOGE momentum18. Release only after exact-current E2E, full regression, QA and governance pass.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: A10 self-repair af1ca16316c144af4665f7d4f4e92e5325d526e3 applied the known-safe exact-three-year/current-only contract patch. Supervisor is now requesting fresh preflight, dashboard E2E, full A01-A11, QA and governance evidence on the repaired code before release.
constraints: Product surfaces expose one current strategy only: V6. Legacy strategy implementations may remain only where required for archived compatibility tests and must not be selectable through the normal UI, API or CLI.
The only runtime strategy/profile source of truth is src/hixton/domain/versions.py. Product configuration stores only strategy key v6 and must not duplicate the V6 digest or per-coin profile map.
Trading mode remains Paper-only. Never send real or testnet exchange orders, never request Binance private credentials, and never present disabled Live preparation as a released product feature.

Operational market data is real public Binance USDC. Same-base USDT history may be used only as explicitly labelled research proxy where USDC listing history is shorter; it is never presented as historical USDC liquidity or fills.

The shared main model starts with 250 USDC and baseline capacity is three 80-USDC slots using ranked_repeat. Multiple slots on one valid signal are capacity tranches of one position cycle, not additional strategy signals.

The permanent portfolio 20-percent drawdown entry halt remains removed. Drawdown is measured and reported. The 5-percent UTC-day loss pause, emergency stop, cash, stale-data and exchange-filter safety gates remain.
The isolated 10x250 model is diagnostic only: ten separate 250-USDC accounts, never a claim that the main account owns 2500 USDC.

Per-coin research freezes a bounded Top-K ranking from training only. Validation may reject but may not silently reselect using holdout knowledge. Every finalist must pass full-window baseline and stress before portfolio testing.
Every robust per-coin finalist is tested alone against the incumbent nine-coin map in shared 3x80 baseline and stress. Only individually portfolio-compatible changes may enter combination assembly.
Every combination step must remain non-regressive versus the already assembled 3x80 under baseline and stress. Final promotion must also preserve aggregate isolated 10x250 baseline and stress.
Paper, 10x250, shared 3x80 and UI must consume the same canonical per-symbol profile hashes. No shadow backtest profile map may be activated.

A strategy promotion changes the immutable V6 digest. The persistent Paper ledger may adopt it only through the explicit audited strategy-activation path after fresh validation; never by deleting or silently resetting the Paper account.
Historical rejected candidates and important lessons are retained in the central backtests/README.md learning journal, but obsolete version directories are not part of the current product surface.
Current DMS and README describe only current normative behavior. Historical decisions live in CHANGELOG/decision history and must not read like active instructions.
The eleven-agent cloud path is deterministic and key-free. No OPENAI_API_KEY or Binance private credential may be required for A01-A11 release verification.
Scheduled research may run autonomously, but automatic merge, automatic live activation and unreviewed strategy promotion remain prohibited.
After every material code/profile/documentation change, invalidate downstream evidence and rerun fresh preflight, affected E2E/regression checks and A01-A11 before claiming a downloadable release.
Normal product backtests have exactly one scenario named current. Baseline/stress variants are not user-facing product results.

For single, isolated 10x250 and shared 3x80, report_start_utc equals report_end_utc shifted exactly three calendar years backwards. The 400 one-hour warm-up bars precede report_start_utc and are excluded from the reported performance window.
If any required market lacks exact three-year coverage plus warm-up, fail closed with an explicit insufficient-history error. Never move report_start_utc forward silently.
The product backtest canonical V6 map includes BTCUSDC vidya_length=5, ADAUSDC band_multiplier=4.4, AVAXUSDC band_multiplier=4.6 and DOGEUSDC momentum_length=18.

The fixed-window regression oracle 2023-09-19T19:00:00Z..2026-09-19T19:00:00Z reproduces approximately 8217.00711069101365 USDC isolated 10x250 and 1217.9057596598351 USDC shared 3x80 using the current scenario.
No downloadable release is approved until the exact release commit has green preflight, dashboard E2E, full regression, A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS.
